status: Visual concept only; not implemented in the game.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: retro pixel-art visual concept for the mobile arcade game Atomic Orbital.
Create one cohesive board showing TWO tall portrait game screens SIDE BY SIDE, straight-on, filling the image. No phone hardware, no perspective, no labels outside the screens. Left is gameplay. Right is the world shop. Both screens belong to exactly the same game.

ART DIRECTION — this is critical:
Authentic hand-crafted 16-bit PIXEL ART, as if drawn carefully in a sprite editor. Logical resolution about 240 by 432 pixels PER screen, enlarged using nearest-neighbor so square pixels are clearly visible. Consistent pixel grid in sprites, scenery, UI borders and bitmap lettering. Clever clustered pixels, intentional stepped curves, limited palette, small selective dithering areas, chunky readable silhouettes. Deep navy space, cobalt oceans, jade continents, warm cream text, mint saucer lights and coral hazards; warm golden-yellow purchase button. Rich character and craft without visual clutter. This must look like an appealing finished indie arcade game. Not simplistic flat vector icons rendered at low resolution. No smooth curves, anti-aliasing, photorealism, glossy 3D, painted textures, gradients, blurry glow, smooth modern typography, CRT effects, scanlines or faux pixel filters over realistic art.

LEFT SCREEN — Cow Abduction gameplay:
Keep the real game geometry plausible and the field spacious. Small bitmap HUD at the top: a continuous segmented-looking but connected health BAR at upper left, big bitmap score "08" near top center, tiny "NORMAL" below the score, and a tiny square pause button at upper right. The health bar is a continuous meter, NOT hearts or discrete lives.
Center the orbital arena around the middle of the screen. The EARTH sprite is approximately 60 pixels in diameter on a 240 pixel-wide logical screen (25% of screen width): a carefully shaded round blue-green pixel planet, recognizable continents, a few white cloud clusters, 3-4 deliberate shade steps, subtle light rim. The Earth has NO face, NO eyes, NO number, NO rectangular score stripe across it.
Two concentric CIRCULAR orbit guides in sparse subdued slate pixels: inner diameter about 96 logical pixels (40% screen width), outer diameter about 216 logical pixels (90% screen width). Readable orbit lanes around the small central Earth. Pixel stair-step circle edges are expected, but the guides must read as circles, not tilted elliptical rings.
A charming little metallic UFO sprite about 16x12 logical pixels sits on the outer orbit, with a turquoise dome and mint lights. One clearly recognizable little FULL-BODY spotted cow collectible, about 18x18 logical pixels, floats at another orbit point; cream body, black spots, pink muzzle, stubby legs, humorous but readable silhouette, a sparse mint pickup sparkle. Do not turn the cow into a circular face badge. Three bright coral-red defense projectiles about 6x6 pixels each between Earth and outer orbit, with tiny short pixel tails only. Quiet near-black space behind the orbital field, a few 1-pixel stars. No large rocks or scenery in the playable arena.

RIGHT SCREEN — a compact arcade world shop:
All UI uses true legible bitmap pixel lettering and crisp stepped borders. A tidy top row with a small back arrow, exact title "WORLD SELECT", and a four-point Stardust icon plus "100".
Small catalog index "01 / 03" above the main title. Main title, exact text: "COW ABDUCTION".
A large appealing PIXEL-ART scene preview dominates the center: an enlarged beautifully shaded pixel Earth about 96x96 logical pixels, the same metallic UFO hovering above one side, lifting the same tiny full-body cow in a tasteful dotted mint tractor beam. This is a shop vignette, so its planet can be larger than in gameplay. Use a few small star sparkles, but leave calm dark negative space around it.
Below the artwork, short pixel caption: "UFO / COWS / DEFENSE".
A prominent golden-yellow rectangular pixel button with a chunky stepped frame and exact text "UNLOCK 150", with a small Stardust icon. The button should look tactile and arcade-like, with a simple one-pixel shadow.
At the bottom, a row of three small square pixel world thumbnails: Classic atomic icon, selected Earth/UFO world with a mint pixel outline, Deep Blue with a little yellow submarine and a blue underwater planet. Tiny labels "CLASSIC", "EARTH", "DEEP BLUE". Small page indicator dots if useful.
No grid of big product cards, no explanatory balance panel, no paragraphs, no smooth pill buttons, no fake wooden/paper UI.

Ensure both screens look like the same polished RETRO PIXEL game, not a generic concept illustration. Clean readable composition at mobile size. Only show the specified text. No watermark.
implementation_notes: Crisp sprite silhouettes, a restrained arcade palette and bitmap typography.
The Earth/UFO/cow world uses a featured preview and a compact world selector.
The image is an art-direction reference, not a pixel-accurate gameplay specification.
Preserve actual hitboxes, orbit geometry, health rules, wallet behavior and scoring when implementing.
